innate.name: Craft output that flows without forcing — Eating God production
innate.behavior: While others are still confirming requirements, you already have a working version running. Given a rough brief, you go quiet, sit down, and the first draft, prototype, or finished piece appears sooner than anyone expected. You do not need mood, inspiration, or perfect conditions to start — the month stem Xin as Eating God sits right beside you, and hidden Xin in the day branch You means the craft literally sits under your feet. In daily life this looks like: cooking a full meal rather than describing one, fixing the thing rather than writing a report about fixing it, teaching by demonstrating rather than lecturing. When you finish a piece you feel lighter, not emptier — that is the signature of this talent: using it drains the excess load of a strong self rather than draining you.
innate.evidence: Eating God is the joint-heaviest force — the month stem Xin, plus hidden Xin in the day branch You and in the year branch Chou, giving it the top weight in the chart. The Day Master Ji earth is listed as strong, so a heavy output god is the healthy release valve: making things literally takes pressure off you. Direct Resource at six weight, from hidden Bing fire in both Si branches, keeps the craft grounded in method rather than chaos.

innate.name: Absorbing and metabolizing hard demands — pressure tolerance under Seven Killings
innate.behavior: When a deadline drops or someone sets a harsh standard, you do not argue, stall, or escalate. You go silent, take the spec, and return with the thing done. In a meeting where others push back on scope, you are the one who simply recalibrates quietly and delivers. This is not passive endurance: hidden Bing fire in the month and hour branches Si acts as Direct Resource, a buffer that converts the incoming demand into method and structure before it hits you raw. You can sit with a difficult requirement far longer than most people, break it into steps, and outlast it. Peers learn quickly that handing you the hard task works — which is exactly how the loop tightens.
innate.evidence: The year stem Yi stands as Seven Killings — external pressure arrives through the front door. But Direct Resource carries solid weight, fed by hidden Bing in the month branch Si and the hour branch Si, and the chart's fire count of two runs through both. The classic pressure-to-buffer pairing is fully present: the demand comes in, the resource layer softens it, and the strong Ji earth self holds the load. Eating God then answers it — the whole chain from pressure to finished work is wired in the visible characters.

innate.name: Self-reliant peer judgment — working alongside rather than managing upward
innate.behavior: You default to doing it yourself or splitting it evenly with people at your own level. In a team you are the reliable equal, not the one maneuvering for the lead chair. When a task stalls, your reflex is to pick it up personally at the hour stem Ji, your mirror self, rather than route it through authority. You keep commitments to peers with unusual consistency — if you said Friday, it is Friday. This earns deep trust from people who work next to you, and it is effortless because it is literally your own element replicated. The cost side is handled elsewhere; the ability itself costs you nothing to run.
innate.evidence: Companion ties Eating God for heaviest weight — the hour stem Ji matches the day master, and hidden Ji in the year branch Chou plus hidden Wu earth in both Si branches stack the same element; the earth count of three confirms it. With a strong Day Master, this self-replication reads as natural peer-mode operation: your energy lives in equals-and-craft territory, not in hierarchy.

trained.name: Producing quietly instead of negotiating loudly
trained.behavior: You answer every demand with more or better work, never with a counter-offer. Someone raises the standard — you deliver above it. Someone takes credit — you build the next thing rather than contest it. The trained reflex is: when squeezed, produce.
trained.trained_by: Year stem Yi as Seven Killings arrived early — pressure from above, standards set by others, was the weather of your formative years. Direct Resource, hidden Bing in both Si branches, taught you to convert demands into method. Repeating this hundreds of times built a production habit so deep it feels like character. The long-term cost: Rob Wealth and Hurting Officer — the ability to compete openly for resources and to challenge terms out loud — carry only two weight each and stay dormant, because producing always worked before. Meanwhile the wealth family runs nearly empty: Direct Wealth carries zero, Indirect Wealth one, and water — your wealth carrier — is absent from all eight visible characters. The work accumulates; the reward does not follow automatically, and no one trained you to close that gap yourself.
trained.evidence: Seven Killings at five weight from the year stem Yi versus Direct Officer at zero and Direct Wealth at zero: authority and reward channels are unloaded while the pressure channel is loaded. Eating God at nine is the trained response that always succeeded, so the negotiating muscles never got exercised.

trained.name: Carrying peers' load without billing for it
trained.behavior: Colleagues hand you their hardest pieces because you take them. You fix, cover, finish — and the asker walks away with the outcome while your name appears nowhere on it.
trained.trained_by: Companion weight of eight with a strong self means you grew up capable early, so capable that extra work routed to you and being equal to it became your identity. Every time you absorbed a peer's task and it went fine, the pattern was reinforced. The cost is slow and structural: your hours convert into other people's outcomes. The ten years from age thirty-two, the Ding Chou stretch, runs more earth — more of the same self-replication — so nothing in the current timing pushes back on this habit; only you can.
trained.evidence: Hour stem Ji as Companion sits beside the day master Ji; earth counts three in the visible branches. Water at zero means the element that would carry returns to you never runs in the visible chart — it first appears in the luck stream only in the Bing Zi pillar from age forty-two and the Yi Hai pillar from age fifty-two.

defensive.name: Silent over-absorption — taking pressure instead of pricing it
defensive.looks_like: Outsiders see unshakeable reliability: the person who never complains and always delivers under any load. It reads as maturity, even toughness.
defensive.actual_cost: Each absorbed demand is paid for from your own reserves. Because Direct Wealth carries zero weight and water is missing entirely, the loop ends at the finished object — nothing banked, no rate, no title, no named credit. The recognition that follows a strong delivery does not convert into standing; it converts into the next, larger demand. You finish more, feel thinner, and the chart's own release valve — Eating God — gets consumed servicing other people's requirements rather than feeding your own projects. Vitality leaks precisely through the thing you are praised for.
defensive.evidence: Seven Killings at five against Direct Officer at zero and Direct Wealth at zero: pressure flows in through a wide channel while the return channels are closed. Direct Resource at six buffers each hit, but the buffer replenishes you only enough to absorb the next one — it does not stop the inflow.

defensive.name: Peer-circle retreat — solving everything through equals and self
defensive.looks_like: People see independence and loyalty: you do not play office politics, you just work with your circle and get things done.
defensive.actual_cost: Because Companion is jointly heaviest, your operating system defaults to horizontal ties, and upward negotiation — where price, promotion, and protection are actually decided — stays unpracticed. Direct Officer at zero means the formal-authority channel is empty in your wiring; without deliberate practice you simply never enter the room where your work is valued. Rob Wealth, the muscle that would fight for resources, sits at two. The comfort of your circle quietly caps the ceiling on what the craft earns.
defensive.evidence: Companion weight of eight on a strong Ji earth self, versus Direct Officer at zero, Rob Wealth at two, and Indirect Wealth at one: the horizontal axis is loaded and the vertical, resource-capturing axis is nearly empty.

one_leverage: Keep the Eating God craft — it is the only force in this chart that both releases your internal load and produces something the world values, and it is fed from three different pillars, so it never runs dry. But attach one condition: every act of craft must now pass through a pricing gate that you build by hand, because the chart gives you zero built-in mechanism for converting output into reward — Direct Wealth is empty, water is absent from every visible character, and the luck stream only starts carrying water from the Bing Zi stretch around age forty-two. From today until then, the gate is yours to operate: before the next hard demand is accepted, write down what returns to you — a rate, a title, a named credit — and treat 'nothing' as an opening to negotiate terms, not a reason to refuse the work. Craft is the engine; the gate is the part you must add yourself, because no timing will add it for you in the years immediately ahead.
